test_title: PYST 36: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the number series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(NOTE: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 1 3 9 6 7 7 7 9 4 4 1 1 5 9 6 5 3 5 9 1 4 3 3 3 3 3 3 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 1 3 9 6 7 7 7 9 4 4 1 1 5 9 6 5 3 5 9 1 4 3 3 3 3 3 3 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca842104cc4246e7fafaf53e329cc03ba74f60e6ea02371dee39eb2b0304c92.png] 

Thus, there is 1 even number, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
